judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a planning artifact (`.lore/dod.md`), a partial spec file (`specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`), and acceptance tests (`src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`), without actually implementing any of the production code. Specifically, `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` and `package.json` (adding `ajv`) are completely untouched, meaning all the newly added tests will fail immediately. Furthermore, almost all other acceptance criteria were omitted, including the `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` test, the `registry.test.ts` file name requirement, logger redaction verification, and updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md`.
